framework.name: CERT-In Directions (April 2022)
framework.description: Directions on information security practices, procedures, prevention, response and reporting of cyber incidents. Apply to service providers, intermediaries, data centres, body corporates and government organisations.

requirements.title: Synchronise ICT system clocks
requirements.guidance: Connect to the NTP servers of the National Informatics Centre (NIC) or National Physical Laboratory (NPL), or to NTP servers traceable to them. Organisations across geographies may use other accurate sources if they do not deviate from NIC/NPL.

requirements.title: Report cyber incidents within 6 hours
requirements.guidance: Report the cyber incident types listed in Annexure I to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing them or being notified of them.

requirements.title: Designate a Point of Contact for CERT-In
requirements.guidance: Designate a Point of Contact to interface with CERT-In and share their details in the prescribed format. Keep the details current.

controls.title: Contact with authorities, CERT-In point of contact

requirements.title: Provide information and assistance when ordered
requirements.guidance: When CERT-In issues an order or direction, provide the requested information or assistance within the stated time.

controls.title: Contact with authorities, CERT-In point of contact

requirements.title: Maintain ICT system logs for 180 days in India
requirements.guidance: Enable logs of all ICT systems and keep them securely for a rolling period of 180 days within Indian jurisdiction. Provide them to CERT-In with incident reports or when ordered.

controls.title: Centralised logging with retention in India

requirements.title: Register subscriber information (data centres, VPS, cloud, VPN providers)
requirements.guidance: Data centres, VPS providers, cloud service providers and VPN providers must register accurate subscriber or customer information and keep it for 5 years or longer as required by law after cancellation or withdrawal of registration.

requirements.title: KYC and transaction records (virtual asset service providers)
requirements.guidance: Virtual asset service providers, exchanges and custodian wallet providers must keep KYC information and records of financial transactions for 5 years.
